info.title: Co-op TCG FRTS Ordering Platform API
info.description:
## Release Notes
      * 1.3.1
      * Updated wholesale product's discount value and percentage properties to correspond with the discount codes
      * 1.3.0
      * 404 responses on retail and wholesale product by ID
      * 1.2.3
      * Specified timezone on timestamps and ensured valid types for fundingTypeCode are numbers not numerical strings
      * 1.2.2
      * Removed promo vat redemption max values, clarified max value cannot exceed retail price in description
      * 1.2.1
      * Added Wholesale product's logistics.storageConditions
      * 1.2.0
      * Moved lastUpdated property from root to individual responses for Retail Products, Wholesale Products, Promotion, Suppliers, Product Hierarchy
      * 1.1.1
      * Updated Wholesale product GTIN length to 14
      * 1.1.0
      * Multi validation error response object structure updated to specify validation error sources
      * 1.0.0
      * Dimensions numerical max values increased
      * All endpoint validation error responses are an array of error messages
      * Precisions removed where not enforced (i.e. not monetary value)
      * Address examples added
      * 0.4.3
      * Added data dictionary IDs to property descriptions and all sales order acknowledgement objects
      * Removed frontOfPackServingText
      * 0.4.2
      * Supplier: isActive not useful as a boolean, may be re-added in future
      * EDN: reweighPricingFactor removed, no one has a real business use case for
      * Wholesale: Channel Islands attributes: loadingGroup, assortmentGrade
      * Product Hierarchy: isActive flag to cover deletion scenario
      * 0.4.1
      * To allow sales order requests to contain different types, orderProcessingType is moved to the order detail level
      * Transportation group example updated
      * 0.4.0
      * After Hazel's feedback, updated volume uom max length, removed characteristics.shelf.productCountyCode, and clarified storePack max value
      * 0.3.8
      * Added firstDeliveryDate
      * Updated storePack max, supplier details required status, and country of origin consistency 
      * 0.3.7
      * Bill of Material properties now optional, Wholesale Product product and catalogue item ID and isActive flag made mandatory
      * 0.3.6
      * Wholesale Product: Cost Prices, Supplier discount, unitConversion integer
      * 0.3.5
      * Wholesale Product: Supplier discount and unitConversion description update
      * costPrices array
      * 0.3.4
      * Single error/rejection list
      * 0.3.3
      * Removed superfluous rejection reason descriptions and calendar description in lieu of codes and mapping table
      * 0.3.2
      * Sales Order Response added accepted array, renamed rejected
      * 0.3.1
      * Product hierarchy name change to productHierarchies
      * Mechanic description and promo change date length udated and tax classification is required
      * 0.3.0
      * promo mechanicDescription, wholesaleProduct unitConversion
      * consistent length date fields, realistic examples instead of unrealistic max values
      * promo descriptions with reference codes
      * promo funding type and category descriptions omitted with code reference tables instead
      * retail and selling price float precision specified
      * provided promo pos example values
      * 0.2.0
      * Funding properties
      * Data tables on transportationGrp, productCountry, duty rate code, product tax code
      * 0.1.6
      * Promotion: casing updates, removed cross out prices
      * PromotionProduct: Add promotionPrice, and productId is not an array
      * PromotionSet: added thresholdQty
      * RetailProduct: added some stricter integer types
      * 0.1.5
      * Alternate customerRetailProduct dimensions removed
      * maximumSellingPrice only for franchisee, so removed
      * unitsInAPack on retail product
      * 0.1.4
      * Removed unused Price Schema
      * Ensure Dimensions are consistent across Retail and Wholesale product
      * Update Retail Product soldInSingles
      * 0.1.3
      * Multipack meeting outcomes
      * 0.1.2
      * Retail Product changes to Ingredients, Dimensions, POS Status, Cross Outs
      * Promotions changes from meeting
      * Added more Data Dictionary reference IDs to descriptions
      * 0.1.1
      * Retail Product changes for multi pack beers and single cans
      * * Breaking change for retailProduct, consumerProducts and retailPrices
      * Added Data Dictionary reference IDs to descriptions
      * Includes Promotions in Master Data
      * 0.1.0
      * Second draft to ISMs
      * No with additional Sales Order and EDN
      * No Promotions
      * 0.0.6
      * First draft to ISMs
      * Master Data only
      * No Promotions
